fact: Tamwilcom reported on 17 September 2026 that the public Fonds Innov Invest financed more than 500 startups with over 590 MDH in aid, loans and investments, and that four funds it structured invested over 500 MDH in about forty startups.
title: Communiqué de presse : Célébration des résultats du Fonds Innov Invest
